name: @tetherto/mdk-plugin-basic-auth
description: DESIGN PROTOTYPE (not wired into templates/minimal-site). HTTP Basic Auth gate for a site's Gateway routes, credentials sourced from SiteLaunch.spec.auth at sites.create time and never handed to this process as plaintext -- only a per-site salt+hash reach it, via env vars. See design/plugin-basic-auth.md for the full write-up, including why this can only protect routes that opt in by calling requireBasicAuth() themselves (no framework-level route wrapping/interception exists) and why failures surface as HTTP 400 rather than a real 401.

200.description: Same payload as dashboard.overview (deviceId/workerId/workerState + spread telemetry), gated behind HTTP Basic Auth.

400.description: Missing/malformed Authorization header, or the submitted username/password don't match the site's configured credential. See plugin-basic-auth.md for why this is 400 and not 401.

routes.description: Demonstrates the shared requireBasicAuth() guard by reproducing templates/minimal-site/plugins/dashboard/controllers/overview.js's exact body with one added line at the top. Ships as its own route (this design task doesn't edit the dashboard plugin) so it is runnable standalone today; wiring the guard onto the real dashboard.overview route later is the one-line change shown in this file's sibling controller.
